goals.zh: 排查登录会话意外失效
goals.en: Investigate unexpected session expiration

zh: 登录老掉
登陆老掉
登录后总要重新登录
登录过一会儿自己退出
en: I keep getting logged out
My login expires unexpectedly
The app keeps asking me to sign in

goals.zh: 排查大数据量列表的渲染性能
goals.en: Investigate large-list rendering performance

zh: 列表数据太多滑动很卡
表格上万行就卡住
长列表滚动不流畅
en: Scrolling thousands of rows is slow
The table freezes with many records

goals.zh: 排查页面加载与交互性能
goals.en: Investigate page loading and interaction performance

zh: 页面打开特别慢
网页加载一直转圈
界面操作很卡
en: The page takes forever to load
The web interface is sluggish

goals.zh: 排查点击交互无响应
goals.en: Investigate unresponsive click interactions

zh: 按钮点了没反应
按下按钮没有动静
点一下按钮界面不动
en: Clicking the button does nothing
The button is unresponsive

goals.zh: 修复移动端响应式布局与内容遮挡
goals.en: Fix mobile layout and overlapping content

zh: 手机上文字和按钮挤在一起
移动端内容被挡住
小屏幕界面错位
en: Text overlaps buttons on mobile
The layout is broken on small screens

goals.zh: 排查保存操作失败
goals.en: Investigate failed save operations

zh: 填写的表单保存不了
保存数据一直报错
内容存不上
en: The form fails to save
My changes cannot be saved

goals.zh: 核对数据口径与结果一致性
goals.en: Reconcile data definitions and inconsistent results

zh: 报表数字对不上
两份统计的数据不一样
金额统计不准确
两个报表算出来的销售额对不上
后台和表格的订单数量对不上
en: The reports show different totals
The numbers in these reports do not match
Sales totals differ between two reports
Order counts differ between the dashboard and spreadsheet

goals.zh: 为输入查询添加防抖
goals.en: Debounce input-triggered searches

zh: 等我输完再搜索
停止打字之后再查询
搜索框每敲一个字就查一次太频繁
en: Search after I finish typing
Wait until typing stops before searching

goals.zh: 检查重复提交与幂等性
goals.en: Check duplicate submissions and idempotency

zh: 订单点两次提交了两遍
重复提交生成了多个订单
连续点击付款导致重复支付
en: Double clicking creates duplicate orders
Submitting twice creates duplicate records

goals.zh: 排查接口请求失败与超时
goals.en: Investigate failed or timed-out API requests

zh: 接口请求一直超时
服务器接口连不上
请求接口失败
en: The API request keeps timing out
Requests to the server fail

goals.zh: 为 Agent 的关键操作设置人工确认
goals.en: Require human confirmation for critical agent actions

zh: agent删除文件前先问我
智能体执行危险操作要确认
让助手改生产环境之前征求同意
en: Ask me before the agent deletes files
Require approval before the agent changes production

goals.zh: 支持 Agent 中断后的任务恢复
goals.en: Resume agent tasks after interruption

zh: agent断了以后接着干
助手中途退出后从上次继续
智能体任务断线后续跑
en: Let the agent continue after a disconnect
Resume the interrupted agent task

goals.zh: 改进 Agent 的上下文与约束保留
goals.en: Improve agent context and constraint retention

zh: agent老忘记前面说过的要求
助手聊久了忘了之前的限制
智能体记不住项目背景
en: The agent forgets my earlier instructions
The assistant loses project context in long conversations

goals.zh: 为 Agent 接入任务所需的工具
goals.en: Connect the agent to tools required for the task

zh: 让agent能用浏览器操作网页
让助手调用公司的工具
智能体需要连接外部工具
en: Let the agent use a browser
Connect the assistant to our tools

goals.zh: 将可独立执行的任务交给多个 Agent 并行处理
goals.en: Run independent tasks with multiple agents in parallel

zh: 几个agent分头干活
让多个助手同时处理不同任务
智能体一起做能拆开的任务
en: Have several agents work on independent tasks
Split the work across agents in parallel

goals.zh: 按匹配字段合并表格并核对结果
goals.en: Merge spreadsheets by matching fields and verify the result

zh: 把几个excel按客户编号合成一张
两张表按姓名对起来
把多份表格按编号汇总
en: Merge spreadsheets by customer ID
Combine these tables using the matching ID column

goals.zh: 按指定字段识别并处理重复记录
goals.en: Identify and handle duplicate records by selected fields

zh: excel里重复的行清一下
表格里同一个客户出现好多次要合并
按手机号把重复记录找出来
en: Remove duplicate rows from the spreadsheet
Find duplicate customer records by phone number

goals.zh: 自动汇总数据并生成定期报表
goals.en: Automate data aggregation and recurring reports

zh: 每周自动把数据整理成报表
每天自动汇总excel生成报告
定时生成销售周报
en: Generate a weekly report automatically
Automatically summarize sales data every day

goals.zh: 按规则批量整理和重命名文件
goals.en: Organize and rename files in batches using rules

zh: 把这些文件按日期批量改名字
文件太多要按规则重命名
自动把下载的文件按月份分类
en: Rename these files in bulk by date
Organize downloaded files into monthly folders

goals.zh: 按条件自动分类邮件并准备回复
goals.en: Classify emails and prepare replies using specified criteria

zh: 收到客户邮件自动分类再写回复草稿
邮件自动归类并帮我拟回复
把咨询邮件分好类准备答复
en: Categorize customer emails and draft replies
Automatically sort incoming mail and prepare responses

goals.zh: 排查游戏对象穿透与碰撞检测
goals.en: Investigate object penetration and collision detection

zh: 角色跑着跑着穿墙了
游戏人物能穿过墙壁
玩家掉到地板下面去了
en: The player walks through walls
The character falls through the floor

goals.zh: 排查游戏掉帧与帧时间波动
goals.en: Investigate frame drops and frame-time spikes

zh: 游戏怪一多就掉帧
打团的时候游戏画面一卡一卡
游戏帧数忽高忽低
en: The game drops frames when many enemies appear
Frame rate fluctuates during combat

goals.zh: 排查游戏存档恢复与进度丢失
goals.en: Investigate save restoration and lost game progress

zh: 游戏退出再进进度没了
存档读回来人物等级不对
游戏重开后存档丢失
en: My game progress disappears after restarting
Loading a save restores the wrong level

goals.zh: 校正音频与画面的时间同步
goals.en: Correct audio-video synchronization

zh: 视频嘴型和声音对不上
剪完视频声音比画面慢
人说话声音提前了
en: The audio is out of sync with the video
The voice does not match the lip movements

goals.zh: 识别语音并生成对齐时间轴的字幕
goals.en: Transcribe speech and align captions to the timeline

zh: 给视频自动加说话的字幕
把视频里讲的话变成字幕
自动识别讲话生成字幕
en: Generate subtitles from the speech in this video
Automatically transcribe and time video captions

goals.zh: 统一不同镜头的色彩与曝光
goals.en: Match color and exposure across shots

zh: 几个镜头颜色不一样想调一致
剪到下一段画面忽然偏黄
不同机位拍的颜色差很多
en: Match the colors across these shots
The camera angles have inconsistent color and exposure

goals.zh: 检查零件配合尺寸与公差设置
goals.en: Check mating dimensions and assembly tolerances

zh: 两个零件装不进去尺寸太紧
孔和轴配不上需要调间隙
零件组装后晃动太大
en: The shaft does not fit into the hole
The assembled parts have too much play

goals.zh: 检查仿真结果对网格划分的敏感性
goals.en: Check simulation sensitivity to mesh resolution

zh: 仿真网格变细结果就不一样
网格加密之后应力差很多
有限元换网格结果一直变
en: Simulation results change when I refine the mesh
Stress values vary with mesh density

goals.zh: 管理图纸版本并追踪设计变更
goals.en: Manage drawing revisions and track design changes

zh: 图纸改了几版不知道哪份最新
工程图版本太多搞混了
设计改动要知道谁改了什么
en: We cannot tell which drawing revision is current
Track who changed the engineering drawings

goals.zh: 使用声音先入的镜头衔接
goals.en: Use an audio lead-in between shots

zh: 先听到下个镜头的声音再切画面
en: Play the next shot audio before cutting to its picture

goals.zh: 使用声音延续的镜头衔接
goals.en: Continue the previous shot audio across the cut

zh: 画面切走了但上个镜头声音继续
en: Keep the previous shot audio after the picture changes

goals.zh: 在人声出现时降低背景音乐音量
goals.en: Lower background music during speech

zh: 有人说话的时候背景音乐小一点
en: Make the background music quieter while someone speaks

goals.zh: 调整片段的渐变变速效果
goals.en: Adjust gradual changes in playback speed

zh: 这个镜头先慢再逐渐变快
en: Make this shot start slow and gradually speed up

goals.zh: 校准字幕与人声的时间对应
goals.en: Align subtitle timing with speech

zh: 字幕比说话晚出来
en: The subtitles appear later than the speech

goals.zh: 梳理论证的前提与结论
goals.en: Identify the premises and conclusion of the argument

zh: 帮我拆开这段话的前提和结论
en: Separate the premises and conclusion in this argument

goals.zh: 区分事实判断与规范判断
goals.en: Distinguish factual claims from normative claims

zh: 这是事实还是在说应该怎样
en: Is this a factual claim or a claim about what ought to happen

goals.zh: 检查证据选择是否存在确认偏误
goals.en: Check evidence selection for confirmation bias

zh: 我是否只找支持自己观点的证据
en: Am I only looking for evidence supporting my own view

goals.zh: 区分不可回收投入与后续决策依据
goals.en: Separate irrecoverable costs from reasons for the next decision

zh: 已经花了很多钱所以舍不得停下来
en: I cannot stop because I have already spent so much money

goals.zh: 设计主动回忆的学习练习
goals.en: Design active recall exercises

zh: 帮我设计不看书回忆知识的练习
en: Help me practice recalling material without looking at the book

goals.zh: 接入检索增强生成，基于相关知识库资料回答并标注来源
goals.en: Add retrieval-augmented generation with source citations

zh: 让AI根据公司文档回答问题
让模型查我们的知识库再回答
en: Have the AI answer using our company documents
Search our knowledge base before answering

goals.zh: 核验模型回答与资料的一致性，对缺乏依据的内容明确说明不确定性
goals.en: Check answers against sources and state uncertainty when evidence is missing

zh: AI总是编造答案
模型回答的东西资料里根本没有
en: The AI keeps making up facts
The model gives answers that are missing from the sources

goals.zh: 约束模型输出的字段和类型，并校验结构化结果
goals.en: Constrain output fields and types and validate the structured result

zh: 让AI每次都按固定字段输出
模型返回的JSON格式总是不对
en: Make the AI return the same fields every time
The model keeps returning invalid JSON

goals.zh: 检查文档分块、召回和重排序，提升知识库检索相关性
goals.en: Review chunking, retrieval, and reranking to improve knowledge-base relevance

zh: 知识库搜出来的内容和问题无关
问公司资料时总是找错文档
en: Knowledge base results are irrelevant to the question
The search keeps finding the wrong documents

goals.zh: 区分可信任务指令与外部内容，检查提示词注入对工具调用的影响
goals.en: Separate trusted instructions from external content and check prompt injection risks in tool calls

zh: 网页里一句话就把AI带偏了
文档里的指令让助手偏离了任务
en: Text on a web page derails the AI task
Instructions inside documents redirect the assistant

goals.zh: 分析输入输出词元、重复请求和缓存命中，在质量约束下降低调用成本
goals.en: Analyze tokens, duplicate requests, and cache hits to reduce cost while preserving quality

zh: AI调用太费token了
相同问题反复请求模型太浪费了
en: AI calls use too many tokens
Repeated model requests for the same question are wasteful

goals.zh: 区分首词元延迟与生成速度，检查模型调用链路并评估流式输出
goals.en: Separate first-token latency from generation speed and evaluate streaming

zh: AI等很久才开始出字
模型回答半天才显示第一个字
en: The AI takes ages to start responding
The first word of the model response takes too long

goals.zh: 建立代表性任务集，对比模型或提示词变更前后的质量、成本和延迟
goals.en: Compare quality, cost, and latency on representative tasks before and after model or prompt changes

zh: 换模型后怎么知道效果好不好
改了提示词想知道有没有变差
en: How can I tell if switching models improved results
Check whether my prompt changes made results worse

goals.zh: 检查任务终止条件、工具重试与步数预算，定位智能体重复执行的原因
goals.en: Inspect stop conditions, tool retries, and step budgets to diagnose agent loops

zh: agent一直重复调用同一个工具
智能体一直转圈停不下来
en: The agent keeps calling the same tool in a loop
The agent keeps running without finishing

goals.zh: 比较提示词、检索增强与微调，选择适合领域任务和数据条件的方案
goals.en: Compare prompting, retrieval augmentation, and fine-tuning for the domain task and available data

zh: 想让模型学会我们行业的说法
想用自己的样本教模型做任务
en: Teach the model our industry terminology
Adapt the model to tasks using our own examples

goals.zh: 核算商品、物流、平台、广告和退货成本，分析订单贡献利润
goals.en: Calculate product, shipping, platform, advertising, and return costs to assess order contribution

zh: 卖了很多单却没赚到钱
跨境订单扣完各种费用不知道赚多少
en: We sell lots of orders but make little profit
Calculate profit after all cross-border order costs

goals.zh: 结合需求、补货周期和安全库存制定补货计划
goals.en: Plan replenishment using demand, lead times, and safety stock

zh: 海外仓经常断货
总是快卖完了才想起来补货
en: Our overseas warehouse keeps running out of stock
We replenish only when inventory is almost gone

goals.zh: 按商品、市场和原因拆分退货，定位可改进环节
goals.en: Break down returns by product, market, and reason to identify improvements

zh: 买家退货越来越多
想知道哪些商品最容易被退回来
en: More customers are returning their orders
Find which products get returned most often

goals.zh: 检查实验分组、样本量和效应区间，评估版本差异
goals.en: Check experimental groups, sample sizes, and effect intervals to assess variant differences

zh: 新版转化高一点是不是就算赢了
测试样本很少能不能下结论
en: Is a slightly higher conversion rate enough to call a winner
Can we draw conclusions from a tiny experiment

goals.zh: 同时查看中位数、分位数和异常值，解释平均值变化
goals.en: Inspect medians, percentiles, and outliers to explain changes in averages

zh: 几个大订单把平均数拉高了
平均值看着很好但大多数订单很小
en: A few large orders inflate the average
The average looks good but most orders are small

goals.zh: 按新增时间分组分析后续活跃和复购，定位留存流失阶段
goals.en: Analyze activity and repeat purchases by acquisition cohort to locate retention drop-off

zh: 用户来了以后就再也不回来了
新客买一次就没再买过
en: Users arrive and never come back
New customers buy once and never return

goals.zh: 拆分访问、加购、结账和支付步骤，定位购买转化流失
goals.en: Break down visits, cart additions, checkout, and payment to locate purchase drop-off

zh: 访问很多但就是没人下单
很多人加购却没付款
en: Lots of visitors but hardly anyone orders
Many people add to cart but never pay

goals.zh: 按问题类型、优先级和响应目标分配工单并跟踪处理时长
goals.en: Route tickets by issue type, priority, and response targets and track resolution time

zh: 客服问题总是没人跟进
买家的问题转来转去没人处理
en: Support requests keep falling through the cracks
Customer issues are passed around without resolution

goals.zh: 区分广告归因收入与实际利润，核对费用、退款和归因窗口
goals.en: Separate attributed revenue from profit and verify costs, refunds, and attribution windows

zh: 广告回报看着很高却还是亏钱
ROAS很好但利润很低
en: ROAS looks great but we still lose money
Ad revenue is high but profit is low

goals.zh: 检查抓取、索引、规范网址和页面内容，定位搜索不可见原因
goals.en: Inspect crawling, indexing, canonical URLs, and content to diagnose search visibility

zh: 商品页在搜索引擎里找不到
网站上线很久了搜索不到页面
en: Product pages never appear in search engines
Our published pages cannot be found in search

goals.zh: 统一渠道参数、转化事件与归因窗口，核对流量和转化来源
goals.en: Align campaign parameters, conversion events, and attribution windows to reconcile traffic and conversion sources

zh: 不知道订单是哪个广告带来的
想分清邮件和社交媒体各带来多少订单
en: We cannot tell which ads generated the orders
Separate orders from email and social media

goals.zh: 在回测中加入手续费、买卖价差、滑点和换手成本，检查收益稳健性
goals.en: Include fees, spreads, slippage, and turnover costs in backtests to assess return robustness

zh: 回测赚钱实盘却亏钱
策略收益算完手续费就没了
en: The backtest makes money but live trading loses
Strategy returns disappear after fees

goals.zh: 核对数据发布时间、信号时点和成交时点，排查前视偏差
goals.en: Check publication, signal, and execution timestamps for look-ahead bias

zh: 回测好像提前知道了后面的价格
用当天收盘价选股又按当天收盘价成交
en: The backtest seems to know future prices
Signals and fills both use the same closing price

goals.zh: 区分训练与样本外区间，通过滚动验证和参数敏感性检查评估泛化
goals.en: Separate training and out-of-sample periods and assess generalization with rolling validation and parameter sensitivity

zh: 参数调得越多回测越好实盘越差
策略换一段时间就失效
en: More tuning improves backtests but worsens live results
The strategy fails on a different period

goals.zh: 分析净值回撤、波动和风险暴露，定位亏损集中阶段与来源
goals.en: Analyze drawdowns, volatility, and exposures to locate concentrated loss periods and sources

zh: 收益看着不错但中间跌得太厉害
想知道组合最难扛的时候亏多少
en: Returns look good but the losses along the way are severe
Measure the portfolio's worst peak-to-trough loss

goals.zh: 检查因子信息系数、分组收益、稳定性和交易成本后的表现
goals.en: Evaluate factor information coefficients, grouped returns, stability, and performance after costs

zh: 不知道这个选股因子有没有用
因子在一个年份有效其他年份不行
en: Check whether this stock selection factor is useful
The factor works in one year but fails in others

goals.zh: 核对分红、拆股和复权口径，解释历史价格与收益的异常跳变
goals.en: Check dividends, splits, and adjustment conventions to explain unusual price and return jumps

zh: 股票分红后图上突然跌了一大截
历史价格调整后算出来的收益不一样
en: The chart drops sharply after a dividend
Adjusted historical prices produce different returns

goals.zh: 明确目标用户和核心流程，划分首版范围与后续需求
goals.en: Define target users and core workflows and separate first-release scope from later needs

zh: 先做个能用的版本
功能太多先做最重要的
en: Build a usable first version
Start with the most important features

goals.zh: 将目标转为可验证的验收条件，覆盖正常流程与边界情况
goals.en: Turn goals into verifiable acceptance criteria covering normal flows and edge cases

zh: 怎么才算这个功能做完了
想把验收要求写清楚
en: How do we know this feature is finished
Make the acceptance requirements clear

goals.zh: 梳理参与角色、操作条件和例外情况，明确业务规则
goals.en: Clarify actors, action conditions, and exceptions to define business rules

zh: 不同情况该怎么处理还没想清楚
需求里有些例外情况没说
en: We have not decided how each case should work
The requirements leave exceptions unspecified

goals.zh: 梳理内容优先级、分组和留白，改善界面信息层级
goals.en: Review content priority, grouping, and spacing to improve information hierarchy

zh: 页面东西太多看不到重点
界面挤满了不知道先看哪
en: The page is crowded and nothing stands out
There is too much on screen to know where to look

goals.zh: 补充加载、成功与失败反馈，让用户知道操作当前状态
goals.en: Add loading, success, and failure feedback so users can understand action status

zh: 点完以后不知道成功没有
保存按钮按了之后没有状态提示
en: I cannot tell whether the action succeeded
The save button gives no status feedback

goals.zh: 检查焦点顺序、弹窗焦点约束与关闭后的焦点恢复
goals.en: Check focus order, focus containment in dialogs, and restoration after closing

zh: 弹窗关了之后键盘不知道选到哪里
用Tab键操作时顺序乱了
en: Keyboard focus gets lost after closing the dialog
Tab navigation jumps in the wrong order

goals.zh: 记录触发步骤、环境和日志，缩小间歇故障的最小复现范围
goals.en: Record triggers, environment, and logs to narrow an intermittent failure to a minimal reproduction

zh: 这个问题偶尔才出现很难复现
同样操作有时成功有时失败
en: This bug happens only occasionally and is hard to reproduce
The same action sometimes works and sometimes fails

goals.zh: 定位修改影响范围，为关联功能补充回归测试
goals.en: Identify the change impact and add regression tests for related behavior

zh: 修了这里另一个功能又坏了
每次改东西都有旧功能出问题
en: Fixing one feature breaks another
Old features break whenever we make changes

goals.zh: 检查测试隔离、异步等待和共享状态，定位不稳定测试
goals.en: Inspect test isolation, asynchronous waits, and shared state to diagnose flaky tests

zh: 代码没改测试一会过一会不过
测试单独跑能过一起跑就失败
en: Tests pass and fail without code changes
Tests pass alone but fail when run together

goals.zh: 对比配置、依赖、权限和网络条件，定位本地与部署环境的差异
goals.en: Compare configuration, dependencies, permissions, and networking between local and deployed environments

zh: 本地能跑上线就不行
开发环境正常服务器上却报错
en: It works locally but fails after deployment
It works in development but errors on the server

goals.zh: 检查数据写入位置、持久化挂载和恢复流程，定位重启后数据丢失
goals.en: Inspect data paths, persistent mounts, and restoration to diagnose data loss after restart

zh: 重启容器以后数据全没了
服务重新部署后上传的文件不见了
en: All data disappears after restarting the container
Uploaded files vanish after redeploying the service

goals.zh: 明确健康检查、分批发布和回滚条件，并验证恢复步骤
goals.en: Define health checks, staged rollout, and rollback conditions and verify recovery steps

zh: 新版上线出问题想退回旧版
发布失败后怎么恢复服务
en: We need to return to the previous version after a bad release
How should we restore service after a failed deployment

goals.zh: 识别扫描文档中的文字和表格，统一字段并标记待核验内容
goals.en: Extract text and tables from scans, align fields, and flag content needing verification

zh: 把这些扫描PDF整理成表格
图片里的表格想变成能编辑的数据
en: Turn these scanned PDFs into a spreadsheet
Convert the tables in these images into editable data

goals.zh: 按可预览的命名和分类规则整理文件，处理重名并保留操作清单
goals.en: Organize files with previewable naming and grouping rules, handle collisions, and keep a processing manifest

zh: 几百个文件想按日期统一改名
文件名乱七八糟想批量整理
en: Rename hundreds of files consistently by date
Organize a batch of files with messy names

goals.zh: 安排定时增量处理，记录进度与失败项并支持从中断处继续
goals.en: Schedule incremental processing, record progress and failures, and resume interrupted work

zh: 每天自动汇总新增文件处理失败还能接着跑
整理到一半断了想从上次继续
en: Summarize new files daily and resume after failures
Continue processing from where the last run stopped

goals.zh: 明确字段映射、唯一标识和变更来源，设计可重试的数据同步
goals.en: Define field mappings, identifiers, and change sources for retryable data synchronization

zh: 想把两个系统的数据自动同步起来
系统之间字段名称不同怎么对接
en: Automatically synchronize data between two systems
Connect systems that use different field names

goals.zh: 检查查询执行计划、索引和数据规模，验证查询性能改进
goals.en: Inspect query plans, indexes, and data volume and verify query performance improvements

zh: 数据库查一点东西也要等很久
数据变多之后查询越来越慢
en: A small database query takes a long time
Queries get slower as data grows

goals.zh: 区分可重试错误，设置退避与上限，并检查重复执行的影响
goals.en: Classify retryable errors, set backoff and limits, and check duplicate execution effects

zh: 接口失败了想自动重试但怕重复处理
对方限流以后一直重试把服务打满了
en: Retry failed requests without processing them twice
Retries overwhelm the service after rate limiting

goals.zh: 检查键盘高度、滚动容器和安全区域，保持输入框与提交操作可见
goals.en: Check keyboard height, scroll containers, and safe areas to keep inputs and submit actions visible

zh: 键盘弹出来把输入框挡住了
手机打字时发送按钮被键盘盖住
en: The keyboard covers the input field
The keyboard hides the send button while typing

goals.zh: 检查应用生命周期、后台限制和连接重建，恢复必要任务状态
goals.en: Inspect lifecycle events, background limits, and reconnection to restore necessary task state

zh: 切到后台回来任务就断了
手机锁屏后再打开进度丢了
en: The task disconnects after switching apps
Progress disappears after locking and reopening the phone

goals.zh: 明确离线可用内容、本地缓存和恢复联网后的冲突处理
goals.en: Define offline content, local caching, and conflict handling after reconnection

zh: 没网络时也想继续看之前的数据
离线改的内容联网后想自动同步
en: Keep viewing previously loaded data without a network
Synchronize offline edits when connectivity returns

goals.zh: 明确用户、角色和资源归属，在服务端校验访问权限与租户边界
goals.en: Define users, roles, and resource ownership and enforce access and tenant boundaries on the server

zh: 不同的人只能看到自己的数据
改一下地址就能看到别人的订单
en: Each person should see only their own data
Changing a URL exposes someone else's order

goals.zh: 检查日志、配置和前端资源中的凭据暴露，规划替换与失效验证
goals.en: Inspect logs, configuration, and frontend assets for credential exposure and plan replacement and revocation checks

zh: 日志里把API密钥打印出来了
浏览器里能看到本来只该服务器用的密钥
en: API keys are printed in the logs
The browser exposes a key intended only for the server

goals.zh: 记录操作主体、目标、时间与结果，明确查询范围和敏感字段处理
goals.en: Record actors, targets, timestamps, and outcomes and define query access and sensitive-field handling

zh: 想知道是谁什么时候改了配置
有人删了数据但是查不到是谁
en: Find who changed the configuration and when
Data was deleted but we cannot identify who did it

goals.zh: 围绕问题整理来源、结论和分歧，把关键陈述关联到可核验引用
goals.en: Organize sources, findings, and disagreements around a question and link claims to verifiable citations

zh: 把这些资料整理成有依据的报告
几篇文章说法不一样想比较证据
en: Turn these materials into a report backed by sources
Compare the evidence behind conflicting articles

goals.zh: 根据学习目标设置评价维度、等级描述和可观察的评分依据
goals.en: Define assessment dimensions, performance levels, and observable criteria from learning objectives

zh: 想让这份作业的评分标准更清楚
不同老师给分差很多想统一标准
en: Make the grading criteria for this assignment clearer
Align criteria when instructors grade very differently

goals.zh: 明确学习目标与先修知识，用概念关系和练习组织学习内容
goals.en: Define learning objectives and prerequisites and organize material through concept relationships and practice

zh: 资料太散不知道先学什么
想把这些知识点串起来做学习计划
en: The materials are scattered and I do not know what to study first
Connect these concepts into a learning plan
